provenance.note: Curated from the Haiku taxonomy: 35 channels / 19 media kept (no true duplicates, no media-like channels); company_strategy -> company_direction, recognition_rewards -> recognition_awards; texts reworded to avoid banned / soft-priming words; csr_volunteering kept with use_in_text=false.

reaction_factors.label: Sender seniority
reaction_factors.description: Messages from C-suite or direct management typically get higher engagement than peer messages

reaction_factors.label: Relevance to own role/department
reaction_factors.description: Employees prioritize messages about their own function (IT reads IT security, Finance reads expense policy) over company-wide

reaction_factors.label: Mandatory vs optional
reaction_factors.description: Mandatory training and compliance messages receive higher response rates; optional content is often skipped

reaction_factors.label: Work value vs personal benefit
reaction_factors.description: Messages about personal benefits (pay, holidays, wellbeing) get more attention than company-wide strategy

reaction_factors.label: Geographic/organizational scope
reaction_factors.description: Employees prioritize messages affecting their office or region; global messages may be deprioritized if not locally relevant
